title: Third Normal Form (3NF) and Transitive Dependencies
realWorldScenario: An employee table contains (emp_id, emp_name, dept_id, dept_manager_name).
questionStatement: Explain why storing dept_manager_name violates Third Normal Form (3NF). What is a transitive dependency?
expectedConcepts: Non-key column depending on another non-key column
hints: Who does the manager belong to: the employee directly, or the department?
